identification: Four Anne Reilly (Australian studio potter, 1980s postmodern style) espresso cups on tripod-footed saucers, black and cream with swirl and dot decoration, one gold/yellow. Likely a Sottsass/Memphis-inspired postmodern studio pottery set.
marks_seen: No mark legible in the single photo (cups and saucer tops only, no base shots); the artist name comes from the lot title. Tag on one handle.
google_searches: Anne Reilly ceramics tripod cup and saucer black white swirl Australian (found only a Bellingen NSW potter Anne Reilly Pottery, a different era); '"Anne Reilly" postmodern cup saucer tripod Sottsass auction sold' (no results)

entries.note: Anne Reilly postmodern Australian art pottery studio cup and saucer, Sottsass 80s; title says one cup and saucer, I could not open the listing page (eBay error) to confirm the number of pieces or the price type

viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, no bids yet (opening bid appears to be $20), premium 22%. Four cup and saucer sets: check the marks underneath for Anne Reilly signature, and for chips to the tripod feet and handles. Only one comparable sale found (Aug 2025, A$142), so the price evidence is thin, but it suggests a four-piece set could be worth more than the estimate if it is the same potter. Could not confirm this is the same Anne Reilly as the 80s postmodern one.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU 3 years: 'anne reilly cup', 'anne reilly pottery', 'anne reilly postmodern' (1 row each, same sale); Terapeak US 'anne reilly cup saucer' (0 rows); Google x2.
flip_reason: 1 sale only (A$142 for a cup and saucer, Aug 2025); if the set of 4 is the same potter it could far exceed the current starting price of about $20, but only one sale so not an easy flip; fragile to post. Check the base marks.
